get_config_funnel_experiment: get the ConfigDict for a funnel distribution experiment with default CRAFT algorithm settings
customize_optimization_step_sizes: customize the aft_step_size, vi_step_size, and craft_step_size in the optimization_config returned by get_config
configure_mcmc_sampling: configure HMC, NUTS, and slice sampling parameters via the mcmc_config in the funnel experiment config
adjust_flow_architecture: adjust the AffineInverseAutoregressiveFlow layers and intermediate hidden dimensions in the flow_config
set_initial_and_target_distributions: set the initial MultivariateNormalDistribution and target FunnelDistribution densities in the config
